tools.name: analyze_whatsapp_chat_messages
tools.description:
WhatsApp chat message analysis tool. Supports delivery-status lookups and chat export. The 'device' parameter accepts a device ID (24-hex), phone number (E.164), or alias — auto-selected if the account has a single device; otherwise the tool errors with the list of available devices so you can ask the user.

Available actions:
- delivery_status: Check delivery and read receipts for specific outbound messages (≤30 days old)
- export: Export chat messages in JSON, CSV, or TXT format

action.description: Action to perform for WhatsApp message analysis operations

device.description: Target WhatsApp device — accepts device ID (24-hex), phone number in E.164 format, or device alias. Optional: if the account has a single device, it is auto-selected; otherwise specify which one.

messageIds.description: Message IDs to check status for (required for delivery_status, max 20)

includeMedia.description: Include media file information in export

includeMetadata.description: Include full message metadata in export

maxMessages.description: Maximum messages to export (paginated under the hood)

tools.name: analyze_whatsapp_chats
tools.description:
Reports and exports of the chats of a WhatsApp number.

Available actions:
- statistics: the team's figures for a period (7 days by default, up to 92): new, resolved and reopened chats, messages received and sent, internal notes, average time to the first reply, to each reply, to resolve and to handle a chat, what was in the inbox at the end of the period, the most used labels and a day-by-day breakdown. Add compareFromDate and compareToDate to compare with an earlier period and get the change in percent. Days are cut at midnight in the account timezone, so for whole days pass local midnights with their offset. Times are in seconds. There is no breakdown per agent or per hour.
- export: Export chats in JSON, CSV or TXT, filtered by status and date, paging through as many chats as requested

Use this tool for: weekly reports, response time reviews, backups, and feeding chat lists into another system.

device.description: WhatsApp device ID connected to Wassenger (24 character hexadecimal string)

limit.description: Maximum number of WhatsApp chats to export (max 1000, fetched in pages of 500)

status.description: Export only: filter by chat status

fromDate.description: Start of the period, e.g. 2026-09-11T00:00:00+02:00. Statistics: defaults to 7 days before toDate. Export: only chats whose last message is after this date

toDate.description: End of the period. Statistics: defaults to now. Export: only chats whose last message is before this date

compareToDate.description: Statistics only: end of the earlier period to compare with

tools.name: create_whatsapp_template
tools.description: Create a WhatsApp message template and submit it to WhatsApp for review (WhatsApp Business API numbers only). It works in steps. Call it with whatever the user has given so far: if anything is missing or breaks a WhatsApp rule, it returns needsInput with the exact questions to ask, and nothing is created. When everything is valid it returns a preview and a confirmToken, still without creating anything. Show the preview; only after the user approves, call it again with the same fields plus the confirmToken. Supports text, image, video, document and location headers, body variables ({{1}} or {{first_name}}) with sample values, a footer, quick reply, URL, phone number and copy code buttons, and authentication (one-time code) templates.

device.description: WhatsApp Business API device ID (24 hex characters) that will own the template. Use get_whatsapp_devices to find it.

name.description: Template name: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, e.g. order_ready

language.description: WhatsApp language code of the template text, e.g. en_US, es, pt_BR

category.description: MARKETING (promotions and offers), UTILITY (order, account or appointment updates) or AUTHENTICATION (one-time codes)

text.description: Text for a TEXT header: up to 60 characters and at most one variable

example.description: Sample value for the {{1}} variable of a TEXT header

mediaUrl.description: Public URL of a sample file: JPEG or PNG for IMAGE, MP4 for VIDEO, PDF for DOCUMENT

file.description: ID of an already uploaded file, instead of mediaUrl

header.description: Optional header shown above the body

body.description: Message body, up to 1024 characters. Mark per-message values with {{1}}, {{2}} or named variables like {{first_name}}; never at the very start or end, and never next to each other. Not used for AUTHENTICATION templates.

bodyExamples.description: One realistic sample value per body variable, keyed by the variable: {"1": "Maria"} or {"first_name": "Maria"}. Ask the user for them; never invent them.

footer.description: Optional footer, up to 60 characters, without variables

text.description: Button label, up to 25 characters (COPY_CODE buttons have a fixed label)

url.description: URL the button opens. End it with {{1}} when each message needs its own ending

urlExample.description: Sample value for the {{1}} at the end of the URL: only that part, not the full URL

phoneNumber.description: Number a PHONE_NUMBER button calls, in international format, e.g. +14155550142

couponExample.description: Sample coupon code for a COPY_CODE button, up to 15 characters

buttons.description: Optional buttons: up to 10 in total, at most 2 URL, 1 PHONE_NUMBER and 1 COPY_CODE, with quick replies grouped together

codeExpirationMinutes.description: Minutes (1-90) until the code expires, shown in the footer

addSecurityRecommendation.description: Add "For your security, do not share this code." to the text

confirmToken.description: Token returned with the preview. Pass it only after the user approved that exact preview.

tools.name: delete_whatsapp_template
tools.description: Delete one WhatsApp message template, in one language, from a WhatsApp Business API number. It works in two steps: called without a confirmToken it only reports which template would be deleted and returns a token, writing nothing; the deletion happens on a second call carrying that token, after the user approved it. It never deletes more than the template it reported, and it asks which language when the name exists in several.

confirmToken.description: Token returned with the confirmation. Pass it only after the user approved deleting that exact template.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_chat_messages
tools.description:
Retrieve WhatsApp chat messages (both inbound and outbound) for a specific device. Backed by the device-scoped Chat Messages endpoint, which requires a Platform subscription on the target device.

Available actions:
- recent: Latest messages in a chat (newest first by default)
- search: Text search across messages (within a chat or device-wide)
- date_range: Messages in a specific time window
- by_sender: Messages sent from a specific phone number or WID
- by_type: Messages filtered by type (text, image, video, audio, document, location, contact, etc.)
- by_id: Fetch a specific message by its WhatsApp message ID
- thread: Get conversation context around a specific message (N before + target + N after)
- media: Messages containing media files

The 'device' parameter accepts a device ID (24-hex), phone number in E.164 format, or device alias (e.g., "Sales 2") — pass exactly what the user named in their request. If the account has a single device, omit it and it will be auto-selected. If the account has multiple devices and the user didn't name one, the tool returns an error listing available devices — ask the user which one they mean.

Comprehensive WhatsApp chat retrieval tool supporting all chat operations through a unified action-based interface. - recent: Most recent chats
- unread: Chats with unread messages
- by_status: Filter by chat status (pending, active, resolved, archived...)

tools.name: manage_whatsapp_campaign_contacts
tools.description:
Universal WhatsApp campaign contacts management tool that handles all campaign recipient operations through action-based parameters. Supports add, remove, and search operations for campaign recipients: phone numbers and groups. Essential for WhatsApp campaign recipient management.

add keeps the recipients already on the campaign. On a campaign that sends a template (WhatsApp Cloud API numbers), give every variable its component exactly as on manage_whatsapp_campaigns create: body, header, header_location, button_url_N or button_copy_code_N, with N the buttonIndex that list_whatsapp_templates reports. Such a campaign only reaches phone numbers, not groups. On a campaign from a number linked by QR, each variable key fills the {{ key }} placeholder of the campaign message.

search.description: Search contacts by phone number, name, or group ID (for search action)

target.description: Filter by contact target: phone number or group WhatsApp ID (for search action)

items.description: Type of WhatsApp contact (user, group, or channel)

kind.description: Filter by contact type (for search action)

status.description: Filter by delivery status (for search action)

channels.description: Channel IDs to remove (for remove action)

tools.name: manage_whatsapp_campaigns
tools.description:
Universal WhatsApp campaign management tool that handles all campaign operations through action-based parameters. Supports search, create, update, start, stop, and delete operations for WhatsApp bulk messaging campaigns. Perfect for comprehensive WhatsApp marketing automation.

What a campaign sends depends on the number. Its connector, reported by get_whatsapp_devices and health_check, says which kind it is: cloud for WhatsApp Cloud API, web for a number linked by QR.
- WhatsApp Cloud API (WABA) numbers: a pre-approved template is required, and it only reaches phone numbers, never groups. Pass template { name, language } and give each recipient the values its variables need. Read the template first with list_whatsapp_templates: every variable it reports has a location (header, body or buttons) and, for buttons, a buttonIndex starting at 0. Send each value with its component, and for a button variable use button_url_N or button_copy_code_N with that index.
- Numbers linked by QR: a message, optionally with a file. Personalize it with placeholders: {{ name }} is the recipient's name, {{ phone }} their number, and each key in a recipient's variables fills {{ key }}. For example message "Hi {{ name }}, your order {{ order }} has shipped" with variables [{ key: "order", value: "A-1043" }]. Write keys and placeholders in lowercase. A placeholder a recipient has no value for disappears from their message; {{ order | on its way }} prints the text after the bar instead.

To send it: create with activate true, which needs settings.date and at least one recipient, or create first and then start, which asks for the same two. If activation fails during create, the campaign is deleted and you have to create it again.

Recipients: pass them on create, up to 2000 per request. To add or remove them afterwards use manage_whatsapp_campaign_contacts. The total a campaign can hold depends on the plan, from 100 on trial to 2000.

What it will cost: before launching a template campaign, estimate_cost gives the price Meta lists per message for each country, in costs: one line per country (or dialling code) with the category of the template and how many messages go there.

Payment problems: when Meta reports one on a Cloud API number's WhatsApp Business account, the templates it sends are rejected (error 131042). A Cloud API number that needs reconnecting stops the same way, because its messages fail until it is reconnected. The three ways to send a campaign (create with activate true, update with activate true, and the start action) then refuse, say why and write nothing. Tell the user, and only repeat the call with confirmPaymentIssue true if they say the payment is already fixed or want to send anyway.

Things that do not undo: delete removes a campaign for good, and stop does not recall messages already handed to WhatsApp.

action.description: Action to perform on WhatsApp campaigns

before.description: Filter campaigns created before this date (for search action)

after.description: Filter campaigns created after this date (for search action)

On numbers linked by QR the link replaces {{form.url}} in message, or is added at its end. On WhatsApp Cloud API numbers the template must have a form link button. Individual recipients only. null removes it (update)

On a template campaign this is the header media, and only for a template whose header is an image, video or document: on a template without a media header the API sends a header the template does not have and Meta rejects it. Upload the file first with upload_whatsapp_file_from_url

message.description: Custom message for this contact (overrides campaign message), with the same {{ }} placeholders. Ignored on template campaigns

url.description: Media file URL for this recipient, for a template whose header is an image, video or PDF. Use it instead of the campaign file to send a different file per recipient

key.description: Variable key, in lowercase. QR campaigns: the placeholder name in the message, e.g. order for {{ order }}. Template campaigns: the placeholder number or name for body variables ("1", "first_name"), or header_1, button_url_0, button_copy_code_0. Buttons are numbered from 0

component.description: Required on template campaigns: the part of the template the value fills (body, header, header_location, button_url_N or button_copy_code_N, N being the buttonIndex from list_whatsapp_templates). Not used on QR campaigns

variables.description: Values for this recipient. On a QR campaign each key fills the {{ key }} placeholder of the message. On a template campaign they fill the template variables, each with its component

contacts.description: Campaign recipients, for the create action only. Max 2000 per request, and the total a campaign can hold depends on the plan (100 on trial, 500 to 2000 otherwise). To add or remove recipients later use manage_whatsapp_campaign_contacts

tools.name: manage_whatsapp_chat
tools.description:

The customer sees none of it. Your team sees the change, and your account's chat webhooks are notified.

Available actions:
- assign: give the chat to agentId, agentEmail or departmentId (departments need a plan that includes them). A pending chat becomes active.
- unassign: take the chat off its agent and department. It goes back to pending.
- add_labels / remove_labels: the labels must already exist on the number, create them first with manage_whatsapp_labels. The chat keeps any label you do not mention.
- resolve: close the conversation.
- reopen: back to active if someone owns the chat, pending otherwise.
- add_note: private note only your team can see (2 to 6000 characters). authorId writes it as that teammate.
- mark_read / mark_unread: marking a resolved chat as unread reopens it.

To write to the customer, use send_whatsapp_message instead.

tools.name: manage_whatsapp_deal_notes
tools.description:
Comprehensive WhatsApp deal note management tool supporting all note operations. A note is what somebody wrote on a sales deal; a note that carries a due date IS a task. Available actions:
- list: Retrieve all notes for a deal with filtering and metadata
- create: Create a new note (optionally as a task with due date, or as a comment on a deal event)
- update: Update note text, due date, completion status, or file attachments
- delete: Remove a note (requires confirmation)

Note: The Sales Funnel API is available on the Platform Professional subscription and above. Write endpoints return HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include it; read endpoints are deliberately NOT plan-gated. Restricted agents (plain agent role) only ever receive their own deals, regardless of filters.

On BOTH create and update this means the COMPLETE list the note carries afterwards, never a delta: ids missing from the list are detached, and an empty array [] removes all of them. tools.name: manage_whatsapp_deals
tools.description:
Comprehensive WhatsApp sales funnel deal management tool. A deal is one sales opportunity tied to a WhatsApp contact, sitting in one stage of one pipeline. Supports listing, retrieving, creating, updating, archiving, moving between stages, linking to chats, and fetching event history.

Available actions:
- list: Retrieve deals with rich filtering (pipeline, stage, status, agent, contact, device, stalled, chatStatus, unread, updatedAfter/Before, pagination)
- get: Retrieve a single deal by ID
- create: Create a new deal (requires pipeline, device, contactWid)
- update: Update deal fields (title, amount, currency, agent, department) - stage moves are NOT here, use move_stage
- archive: Archive a deal (frees the contact's open-deal slot, preserves as sales history)
- move_stage: Move a deal to another stage (requires previousStage for atomic compare-and-swap)
- link_chat: Link a deal to a WhatsApp conversation by contactWid
- events: Fetch deal event history (limit, skip)

Important notes:
1. move_stage requires previousStage - the stage the client last saw. The server performs an atomic compare-and-swap and answers 409 when it no longer matches. Always read the deal first (action: 'get') and pass its current stage value.
2. Only ONE open deal may exist per contact per pipeline. The API answers 409 otherwise, and the check spans the @c.us/@lid identity equivalence.
3. Restricted agents (plain agent role) only ever see their own deals, regardless of filters.
4. Write operations (create, update, archive, move_stage, link_chat) require the Professional plan or above. Read operations (list, get, events) are not plan-gated.

tools.name: manage_whatsapp_pipelines
tools.description:
Comprehensive sales pipeline management tool for the WhatsApp sales funnel (CRM). A pipeline is a sales board: an ordered list of stages that deals move through, optionally fed by specific WhatsApp numbers. Use it to set up sales boards, inspect their configuration and read their headline numbers.

Available actions:
- list: Retrieve all sales pipelines of the account, optionally only those fed by one device
- get: Retrieve a single pipeline with its full stage configuration
- create: Create a new pipeline with stages, entry rules and behaviour settings
- update: Update pipeline properties, stages, lost reasons or settings
- delete: Remove a pipeline (refused with 409 while it still holds open deals)
- summary: Per-stage deal counts and open amount totals for the board, plus won and lost totals for the last 30 days

Stage ordering matters: a pipeline requires at least one open, one won and one lost stage, and the won and lost stages must come AFTER all the open ones, because a deal advances to the next open stage by position. When no stages are supplied on create, a sensible default ladder is seeded.

Note: the sales funnel is available on the Platform Professional subscription and above. Write operations answer 403 on a plan without it, while reads stay available so an account that downgrades keeps access to its funnel data.

search.description: Search files by filename, tags, or reference ID

origin.description: Filter by upload origin: upload (local file) or remote (URL)

after.description: Filter files created after this date (ISO 8601 format)

size.description: Number of files to return per page

tools.name: send_whatsapp_flow
tools.description: Send a published WhatsApp Form (Meta WhatsApp Flow) to a chat as a native interactive message: one message instead of asking question after question. Only works within the 24h customer-service window; to start a conversation, send a template whose button opens the form. Pass a token to match the answers to your own record (it comes back in the message:flow:response webhook), and data to prefill the form.

device.description: Target WhatsApp device ID (24 character hex string)

phone.description: Recipient phone number in international format (E.164), e.g. +34600111222

flow_id.description: The WhatsApp Flow ID to send (flowId from list_whatsapp_flows)

cta.description: Text of the button that opens the form (max 30 chars)

body.description: Message text shown above the button (max 1024 chars)

screen.description: Screen to open. If omitted, the form opens on its first screen.

token.description: Your reference for this send (an order or ticket id). It comes back with the answers.

data.description: Values to prefill the form with, by field name

header.description: Header text above the message (max 60 chars)

footer.description: Footer text under the message (max 60 chars)

idempotencyKey.description: Your unique key for this message, 6 to 36 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key when retrying the same message: the API then answers 409 Conflict with the id of the message already created instead of sending it twice. Use a new key for every different message.

tools.name: send_whatsapp_message
tools.description:
Comprehensive WhatsApp message sending with action-based operations. Supports all message types including text, media, location, contact, poll, event messages, with scheduling, live delivery, expiration, agent messaging, and template support. All message sending operations unified in one tool.

Scheduling: pass exactly one of deliverAt, delay or delayTo on the text, media, template, agent or scheduled actions. Leaving all three out sends the message right away. On WhatsApp Cloud API (WABA) numbers a plain text, media or agent message still needs the customer to have written within the last 24 hours at delivery time, so a reminder that lands later than that must use the template action.

action.description: Action to perform for WhatsApp message sending

chat.description: WhatsApp chat ID (e.g., 1234567890@c.us for phone numbers, 123456789000000000@g.us for groups, 123456789000000@newsletter for WhatsApp channels)

device.description: Target WhatsApp device ID (24 character hex string) used for message delivery. Only required if you have multiple WhatsApp numbers connected. Use MCP tool "get_whatsapp_devices" to retrieve a list of available devices.

message.description: Text message content (required for text, scheduled, live, expiring, agent, template actions)

previewUrl.description: Enable URL preview in messages (for text, template actions)

deliverAt.description: Absolute ISO 8601 instant to deliver the message at, with a time zone (e.g. 2026-09-20T09:00:00+02:00). Must be in the future and less than a year away

delay.description: Deliver the message after this many seconds (max 31536000, a year)

delayTo.description: Deliver the message after a duration: 30m, 2h, 3d, 2w, 1M (max a year)

url.description: Public URL of the media file

format.description: Media format (gif for GIFs, ptt for voice notes)

contacts.description: Array of contacts to send, max 10 (required for contact action)

secret.description: Hide vote results until poll ends

agentId.description: Agent ID for agent messaging (required for agent action)

actions.description: Actions to perform after message delivery (for agent action)

value.description: Text value to replace the placeholder

amount.description: Amount in minor units multiplied by 1000 (e.g. 10990 for $10.99)

token.description: Your reference for this send; it comes back with the answers

data.description: Values to prefill the form with, by field name

flow.description: For a template whose button opens a WhatsApp Form

reference.description: Custom reference ID for message tracking

sendReadAck.description: Send chat read acknowledgment after the message is delivered

idempotencyKey.description: Your unique key for this message, 6 to 36 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key when retrying the same message: the API then answers 409 Conflict with the id of the message already created instead of sending it twice. Use a new key for every different message.

tools.name: update_whatsapp_file_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata and properties of an uploaded WhatsApp file. You can modify filename, tags, expiration time, access permissions, format, and reference ID to better organize and manage your files.

message.description: Default caption text for media messages (images/videos only)

tools.name: upload_whatsapp_file_from_url
tools.description: Upload a file from a remote URL to the WhatsApp platform for use in media messages. The file will be downloaded from the provided URL and stored securely. Returns the uploaded file details including ID for use in message sending.

url.description: Public URL from which to download file contents

filename.description: Custom filename for the uploaded file

format.description: File presentation format (gif for videos as GIF, ptt for audio as voice note)

reference.description: Optional reference identifier for file tracking

tools.name: validatePhoneNumbers
tools.description: Validates the format of given phone numbers according to E.164 standard and checks their potential validity. Can validate up to 500 phone numbers at once.

phoneNumbers.description: Array of phone numbers to validate in E.164 format (max 500)

tools.name: verifyWhatsAppNumberExists
tools.description: Checks if a given phone number is associated with an active WhatsApp account.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number to verify in E.164 format
